tasks.title: Protected forms accept bounded list fields and shared writes support incident and maintenance audit targets
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, contract pin, shared infrastructure in Behavior and unit Checks; Required behavior 1-3 (dispatcher, list fields, body limits and ApiCall), 10-11 (shared sender and People targets); Security impact (auth order, body limits and dependency pins). Pin contract to c4a2eb5214d48d40d0c1afbae5e3e49463185e15 or a later full main SHA containing 2.3.0 and regenerate bun.lock. Add optional ProtectedRoute.listFields and required PageRequest.lists, empty on GET/HEAD. Thread list parsing through the existing readFormFields/readPostForm pipeline in src/http-context.ts and protected dispatcher in src/server.ts; preserve callers without list fields and the fixed POST order. Add the two form limits, reject duplicate list values and over-limit counts, and never allow csrf/form_token as lists. Add the four ApiCall names and seven PeopleAction values and the incident/maintenance target encodings from section 11. Export/generalize the check sender and People-row helper with per-resource texts, optional revision and resource identifiers, keeping existing check write behavior and tests green. Update the existing PageRequest literal in token-write.test.ts with empty lists so the typecheck stays green at this step. This task supplies shared support only; resource-specific routes, outcome policies and calls follow in T2/T3. Update configuration docs for list-field validation and limits. The existing shared POST pipeline and regression suites are supporting paths beyond the plan's Files list, required to carry lists without duplicating the security checks. Request counting: shared dispatcher refusals stop before the handler (0 reads and 0 writes); live write guards run after handler reads and prohibit only writes. Preserve the existing gate-based testing pattern in server.checks-write.test.ts for the new route tests in T2/T3.

tasks.title: People can inspect, publish, update, resolve and delete incidents with a live status-card preview
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, incident portion of Behavior, Fake API, Checks and Docs; Required behavior 1-10, incident portion of 11 and 14; Counterexamples through Private filtering; Acceptance evidence 1-2 and 4-8 (incident routes). Implement the complete incident vertical feature on T1's shared support: bounded public-only reads, first-failure states, 404-as-empty manual list, list filters/order/200-row bound, separate MTTR populations and duration formatting, manual timelines and read-only automatic detail/results, composer and automatic shortcut, post update, resolve and typed-title delete. Register exact raw-path protected routes and roles, validate query ids, and set incident navId; both navigation entries are enabled together in final T3 after both page families exist. Implement contract-based CRLF-normalized forms without trimming title/message, component validation, route/JSON byte limits and every outcome in section 10. Every accepted write is guarded immediately before the one outbound request; no If-Match for incidents, no retries or followed redirects, and section 11's id-only logs/People rows. Compose the resolve page in incident-pages.ts with existing html.ts field/error/button helpers; leave confirm.ts and its tests unchanged. Both open resolve GETs issue independent tokens; already-resolved update/resolve POSTs keep text and return 409 with zero writes, while a read/write resolution race shows the API's 409 after one write. Delete uses the shipped trim/NFC helper, known revision field equal to update count without a POST revision comparison. Implement escaped server preview and independent textContent live preview in the sole existing console script, unchanged CSP, one input/change listener, no request/storage/timer; resolved preview shows all updates and open preview the latest only. Add the stateful manual-incident fake with contract validation, auth, an ordered record of every request as {method,path} for separate read/write counts, gated read replies for role/session changes, 100-update limit, private-item switch and resolve-after-read switch, reused by HTTP/browser fixtures. Add incident HTTP/unit/browser tests and docs in this task, including mobile/axe/focus, JS-server parity and no-JS flows; T3 extends the same fake/harness for maintenance. Cover every incident Counterexample and every incident row of Required behavior / Request counting: assert ordered read paths and writes separately, including success, preview and handler refusals. No request follows the write. Dispatcher refusals alone require zero API requests; typed-title mismatch, forged status, already-resolved input and live-guard refusals retain their specified reads and require zero writes.

The literal MTTR cases give 20 min with 2 resolved, 18 min for 1050000 ms, and — for no sample; filters do not change samples; manual sample 50 is labelled the 50 most recent; exactly 1000 automatic items suppress automatic MTTR; resolvedAt=now-1209600001 is excluded. Durations 29999/30000/5400000/93600000 give under 1 min/1 min/1 h 30 min/1 d 2 h. Open rows precede resolved, ties put manual before automatic then higher id; only 200 rows render. Manual #7 and automatic #7 stay distinct, equal-time updates retain #1 then #2 order, and shortcut publish leaves the automatic incident unchanged. Viewer forged writes and Member delete give 403 with 0 API requests; CSRF and replay refusals stop in the dispatcher (0 reads, 0 writes). A gate on the composer config read lets a test lower the role or delete the session after token acceptance: 403 or 409 Not saved, exactly 1 read and 0 writes; no production hook. Assert literal ordered read/write counts for every incident row of the spec's Request counting table: list 3/0; manual detail 2/0; automatic detail 3/0 when found (2/0 when absent); composer GET 1/0, or 2/0 with from; composer preview 1/0 and publish 1/1; resolve GET 2/0, delete GET 1/0; update/resolve preview 2/0 and publish 2/1; delete POST 1/1. Preview returns 200 with 0 People rows; publish/update/resolve/delete return the specified 303 locations and saved rows. Two resolve tabs have independent tokens: preview refreshes the first token, publication resolves, then the saved second unused token POST gives 409 with exactly 2 reads and 0 writes; later GET resolve gives 409 without form_token and detail has no update/resolve form. Forged update status resolved returns 422 after exactly 2 reads and 0 writes. Resolve race sends exactly 2 reads and 1 write and shows API 409. For Slow checkout, slow checkout and Slow  checkout give 422 'The name does not match. Type Slow checkout exactly.'; blank gives 422 'Type the name to confirm.'; each mismatch reads only GET /manual-incidents/<id> (1 read, 0 writes), never a posted title; trailing space and decomposed Café succeed. 32769 incident-form bytes give 413. All section 10 failure rows keep input as prescribed; unreadable create redirects to /incidents?published=1, failed saved People row returns 200, composer timeout returns 504 after exactly 1 GET /admin/config and 1 POST /manual-incidents (2 API requests total), no retry or later read, and People value unknown. Admin-token scan of responses/logs/database and title/message scan of logs/People rows give 0 hits. A focused run may fail only the global 80% line-coverage gate

tasks.title: People can plan and manage durable maintenance windows and both screen families pass final evidence checks
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, maintenance portion of Behavior and Fake API, navigation Checks, maintenance and whole-change Checks, Docs and Completion evidence; Required behavior 1-3 and 11-14; maintenance Counterexamples (Time parse through Phase boundary); Performance impact, Security impact, Rollout order 1 and Acceptance evidence 1-8. Build the Maintenance list, phase/source/shadowed views and all role-aware actions; create/edit with coherent maintenance/config revisions (one retry only), immutable id on edit, direct-check plus component selection snapshot, UTC round-trip parsing and unchanged millisecond preservation from the edit POST's own GET /admin/maintenance, contract validation, If-Match and maintenance-specific outcomes; delete database/shadowed copies with existing plainConfirmPage fields only. Enforce guards, list/body/JSON limits, stale input retention with zero window writes, unknown handling without retry and id-only People rows/logs. Extend T2's stateful fake with database/file/shadowed windows, injected phases, common revision and the exact API status semantics listed in Fake API, arbitrary stored epochs (including start 1793959200123), all-request recording and gated replies. For edit POST, always read /admin/maintenance then /admin/config before revision comparisons; both must equal the posted revision. Obtain original start/end only from windows[] source database with id equal to target, never from /admin/config or posted/hidden epochs. After those 2 reads, stale revision, shadowed/file-only target or missing target prevents all writes; no POST read retry. Read failure stops with the section 3 failure state. A forged shadowed/file-only edit is refused by the console precheck, not sent to the API. Register maintenance routes and enable both Incidents and Maintenance navigation entries together for every role; leave only Activity/System unavailable. Add maintenance unit/HTTP/browser tests beside implementation and extend fixture --serve for the complete manual journey. Finish docs, full suite/browser checks, required existing deploy-dev Compose job evidence, agent-browser lifecycle/mobile record and local-api smoke. The final security/evidence review covers all of T1-T3, including earlier incident tests and the maximum four API requests for the maintenance form retry. No API/contract/status product changes and no changes to confirm.ts or CSP. Map acceptance check 8 to one HTTP test per row of Request counting (incident rows from T2 and maintenance rows here); separate total API requests, GET reads and mutations throughout tests, docs and PR evidence. The maximum remains 4 requests for a maintenance form GET retry; an edit POST has 2 reads plus at most 1 write. Include gated role-lowered/session-removed maintenance edit refusals after 2 reads and before any write.

Shadowed/file-only edit GET gives 409 without form; forged edit POST gives console 409 after 2 reads and 0 writes; unknown edit gives 404 after 2 reads and 0 writes. The PR names #569 and records bun run check, check:browser, actual agent-browser commands/outcomes and local-api smoke. Docs cover routes/roles/scopes, both MTTR populations and limits, preview time/layout exclusions, automatic shortcut, draft behavior, maintenance snapshot/stale/source/phase rules, and outcomes; index links both guides and AGENTS names the suites and preview/list-field behavior. PR states real status parity is checked in the dependent deploy child, automatic 14-day/1000-row and manual 50-result limits, and unknown write outcomes. Request-count evidence distinguishes all API requests from mutations, covers typed-title mismatch (1 read, 0 writes), forged update status (2 reads, 0 writes), composer timeout (1 read, 1 write), role change after reads (composer 1, edit 2; 0 writes), and database-millisecond preservation (2 reads, 1 write).
